responsibility: Central implementation of #pragma handling shared by the C-family front ends. It parses and executes built-in pragmas such as pack, weak, GCC diagnostic/target/optimize option pragmas, scalar_storage_order, ivdep, unroll, OpenMP/OpenACC deferred pragmas, and PCH pragmas; manages pragma registration tables for built-ins and plugins; and provides invocation support for normal and early pragma handlers.
same_name_distinction: Runtime implementation of shared pragma handling: it parses and executes built-in pragmas, manages pragma registration tables, and dispatches normal and early handlers, whereas c-pragma.h provides the shared enums, handler types, lexer declarations, and registration/invocation interfaces.
